title: hw-nodes manifest
description: Per-repo manifest consumed by the labgrid-plugins hw-matrix reusable workflow. One entry per labgrid place.

place.description: labgrid place name as registered on the coordinator

runner_label.description: Self-hosted GH Actions runner label, e.g. hw-bq

env_remote.description: Repo-relative path to a committed LG_ENV yaml used by the coord leg

direct_env_var_name.description: Runner-side env var holding the direct-mode LG_ENV path

tests.description: Test file or selector arguments passed to pytest for this place

extra_pytest_args.description: Additional flags appended to the pytest invocation for this place

xilinx_board.description: Optional FPGA family hint; consumers may use it to gate Vivado sourcing

board.description: Optional daughter-board / chip identity (e.g. ad9081). Used to label the matrix leg; falls back to `place` when unset.

carrier.description: Optional FPGA carrier name (e.g. zcu102). Paired with `board` in the matrix leg label.

legs.description: Which leg(s) to run. Defaults to both.
